task_name: Biomolecular Complex Structure Prediction with Diffusion Model
primary_goals: Design a diffusion-based model architecture for biomolecular complex prediction
Process protein (PDB) and ligand (SDF) input data
Generate structural predictions with uncertainty estimates
Evaluate prediction accuracy using RMSD metrics
related_work_foundations: AlphaFold (Jumper et al., Nature 2021) - Protein structure prediction with deep learning
Geometric Deep Learning (Bronstein et al.) - Non-Euclidean neural networks
Transformer (Vaswani et al.) - Attention-based sequence modeling
Diffusion Models - Iterative denoising for generative modeling
